description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance across six training epochs for four different quantization configurations of the Whisper small model. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The vertical y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major grid lines and tick labels every 2.5 units. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid orange line with circle markers) starts at WER 35.5 at epoch 0, peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2, then declines to 31.5 by epoch 6. “small AdaLoRA_int8” (solid brown line with circle markers) begins at 30.0, rises slightly to 30.5 at epoch 1, then steadily decreases to 25.5 at epoch 6. “small int4” (dashed orange line with square markers) starts at 30.0, peaks at 33.5 at epoch 1, then drops to 25.0 at epoch 6. “small int8” (dashed brown line with square markers) begins at 30.0, rises to 33.5 at epoch 1, peaks again at 34.0 at epoch 2, then declines to 26.0 at epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend after epoch 2, indicating improved performance with additional training, though the AdaLoRA_int4 variant exhibits the highest initial error and largest peak.
